target.title: fix(agents): suppress unhandled rejection from async abort callback
target.body:
## Summary

Add .catch() with process.stderr.write diagnostic to the agent session extension abort callback. waitForIdle() rejection now logged instead of crashing.

## Real behavior proof (required for external PRs)

**Behavior addressed**: void this.abort() in extension callback → waitForIdle() rejects → unhandledRejection → crash

**Real environment tested**: Linux, Node 22, OpenClaw main

**Before**: void this.abort() — crash on rejection
**After**: void this.abort().catch((err) => process.stderr.write(...)) — logged

**What was not tested**: Live waitForIdle() rejection

## Risk

Low. Error logged to stderr for observability.
